name: English Muffin
siboNotes: Contains wheat-based fructans which can trigger SIBO symptoms. Avoid during elimination phase and consider gluten-free alternatives.
preparationTips: Toast lightly to improve digestibility for some people
Remove excess crumb if very sensitive to fructans
Check ingredient list for added high-FODMAP ingredients like honey or inulin
Consider sourdough varieties which may be better tolerated due to fermentation
alternatives: Gluten-free English muffins made with rice flour
Sourdough English muffins (may be lower FODMAP due to fermentation)
Rice cakes as a similar base for toppings
nutritionalHighlights: Iron fortification in most commercial varieties
